description: Source code for managing device endpoints, including functions for creating, cloning, printing, converting to/from JSON, and destroying device endpoint structures in a C project.

methods.name: endpointDestroy
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for an icDeviceEndpoint, including its resources and metadata lists.

methods.name: endpointPrint
methods.description: Prints details of an icDeviceEndpoint, including resources and metadata, with indentation.

methods.name: endpointClone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an icDeviceEndpoint, including its resources and metadata lists.

methods.name: endpointToJSON
methods.description: Converts an icDeviceEndpoint structure to a cJSON object.

methods.name: endpointsToJSON
methods.description: Converts a list of icDeviceEndpoint structures to a cJSON object with endpoint IDs as keys.

methods.name: endpointFromJSON
methods.description: Creates an icDeviceEndpoint structure from a JSON object.

methods.name: endpointsFromJSON
methods.description: Creates a list of icDeviceEndpoint structures from a JSON array.
